courses.name: Massey Park Golf Club
courses.notes: 18 holes beside Exile Bay, par 66 (women 68: holes 1 and 18 are par 5 for women). Blue tees 4525m; GolfFinder also lists white 4312m and red 4366m, but no hole-by-hole lengths for those. Green fees are for 18 holes, any day (from 1 July 2026): 9 holes $30.50, twilight $25. Book online (MiClub public bookings) or call the pro shop, 02 9743 3737; same-day bookings and cancellations by phone. Hole 18a is a spare hole used when another is out for maintenance; not on the card here. Stroke index from Hole19. The club's course guide calls the 1st the toughest hole and the 7th the easiest, which matches Hole19 (SI 1 and 18); 18Birdies has a different order (1st = 2, 18th = 1) and conflicts with the club on both. No handicap rating stored: none published by Golf Australia was found. Seen elsewhere: 63.5 / 113 (18Birdies, men, these tees), 63.0 / 113 (a forum handicap post), slope 117-119 (GolfFinder). Take the scratch rating and slope from the card or GolfLink. Red tees (Oct 2026) from a course GPS app, red tee to middle of the green, metres: 391, 159, 248, 246, 450, 126, 299, 267, –, 292, 137, 195, 257, 161, 118, 257, 257, 365 (4,243 m without hole 9). The app shows no red length for hole 9, so hole 9 has no red here and falls back to the blue 156 m when the red tee is chosen. The same app gives a different stroke index from Hole19's (holes 1–18: 2, 7, 12, 13, 6, 9, 16, 10, 5, 11, 15, 3, 14, 8, 4, 17, 18, 1); the stored order is still Hole19's until the club's card settles it.
courses.source: Card: Hole19 (blue, metres) and 18Birdies (same tee in yards; every hole agrees within 1m); par 66 and hole notes: masseypark.com.au/course-layout; fees: GolfFinder and GreatClubReview (Oct 2026), the club's fee card is an image; location: OpenStreetMap way 173947871 (ODbL, © OpenStreetMap contributors).
